text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: How did I end up here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...!
This roller coaster...
It's a tough one, to
be sure.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I will accept its challenge and
emerge victorious! Come—we
ride to
battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This chaos all started a few hours ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm spending the afternoon in town on my
day off when I spot Yaeno
reading flyers
on a train station billboard.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought long about the break I was
supposed to take. I concluded that I
should take action and start searching for
activities that could distract me from
training long enough to rest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That said,
I live by the discipline of martial
arts. I'm embarrassed to admit that I am
not familiar with many recreational
sites in the area.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is my chance to get her mind off training. I know just the place—somewhere anyone would enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The theme park... What an astute
suggestion. I believe that may allow
even
one as myself to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's settled—let us be off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, here we are.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whew... That roller coaster was
formidable, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fun? Naturally, I enjoyed the experience,
but more than that... I was
impressed by
the acceleration on the downward slopes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There are races with declines too. I've
practiced for them, but this
ride has given
me new ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not gonna lie, I was expecting "Yeah!"—not a deep dive into the racing applications of roller coasters. I've gotta get her mind off training fast!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's too dark...
Trainer! Where did you go?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm, my eyes are slowly adjusting.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Ghost?
text_block_list.text:
Heeeehehehee! None who enter this
mansion will ever see the light of
day
again!

text_block_list.name: Ghost?
text_block_list.text: Hope you're ready for a spook!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A spook?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAH!

text_block_list.name: Ghost?
text_block_list.text: Ack?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Do not think the dim light will hide you!
Wretched spirit, you'll pay
for whatever
you've done to my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems to have fled that way.
Hehe... You can't outrun me!

text_block_list.name: Monster?
text_block_list.text: BOO! Heehee! Bet that gave you a fright!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not a chance! Now take this! Kongo
Yaegaki's ultimate finisher—

text_block_list.name: Monster?
text_block_list.text: EEP?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, get behind me! I'll fend off this
beast!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Good. I kept a level head even before
supernatural foes. That was
an excellent
exercise in willpower... Wait!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I... I almost tried to connect the
experience to my training. I'm sorry!
You
invited me here to relax, and yet I
betrayed your goodwill!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to be practicing restraint,
not using every event as a
learning
experience. Ah, what an amateur mistake!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh? But, I... I couldn't possibly ask you to help me practice not practicing. It'd be ridiculous...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I already caused you so much trouble over
my break... And now I'm
troubling you
again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about me. I swear to
you that I'll overcome this
trial myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not backing down. This is the kind of guidance that trainers are for.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... It's... fun?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno looks at me, dumbfounded. It's
getting late, though, so we
decide to call
it for the day and head home to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the train, Yaeno speaks up softly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is it truly okay?
For me to keep trying and
failing...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I recognize that I'm immature...
and that's a
large part of why I devote
myself to
practicing self-discipline.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I think it's also why, deep down, part of
me was against your decision
to let go of
that training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So now...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No,
nothing. Allow me to think it over a
little more first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno falls silent.
She doesn't say another
word the whole way back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand a bit better now, though.
She's been relying on training to harness
her energy for so long. Managing herself
without it could be a good experience for
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll be here to support her through it.
Summer's right around the
corner, so now's
the perfect time!
